tasks.title: Trace race completion through post-race phases to the Results destination
tasks.question: What is the evidence-backed caller/callee path from per-racer finish through manager-level race completion and post-race phases to the concrete Results panel, substate, or scene/resource transition?
acceptance_criteria: Pin every consulted public source to an exact commit and executable/version context where known
Trace per-racer finish, manager completion condition, post-race phase writer, and Results destination as separate edges
Label each edge by platform and evidence level; do not infer GameCube/Wii behavior from PC or N64 findings
Record unresolved fields, callers, resources and runtime-only questions instead of guessing
Publish one focused research dossier without copying third-party code or game-derived assets

tasks.title: Require verified evidence for autonomous cycle progress
tasks.question: Do autonomous progress reports correspond to a real open, non-empty same-repository PR at its exact live head?
acceptance_criteria: Gemini and OpenRouter require PROGRESS evidence or a named BLOCKED report
Live GitHub state confirms the PR is open and its head repository is this repository
Live PR head SHA equals the reported 40-character SHA
A missing, forked, stale, closed or empty PR cannot count as progress
tasks.next_action: Review exact-head CI for PR #287, then verify the first real scheduled cycle after merge.

tasks.title: Avoid repeated autonomous Gemini and OpenRouter Free calls and bound agent context
tasks.question: Can autonomous free-provider failures be remembered for the current UTC day, while both agents restrict historical issue context to current state and the latest relevant comments to reduce repeated quota/context waste?
acceptance_criteria: One persistent marker on issue #226 records the UTC date of an autonomous Gemini CLI invocation failure

A matching same-day Gemini marker blocks another Gemini model request before token mint, checkout and model invocation, while the caller may proceed to the independently gated OpenRouter Free fallback
A separate persistent marker records an autonomous OpenRouter Free invocation failure
A matching same-day OpenRouter marker blocks token mint, checkout, CLI installation and the fallback model request
Only failed provider invocation steps write their respective markers; blocked preflight and same-day skips do not
Each marker is updated in place, is independent from the other provider marker, and expires by date comparison on the next UTC day
Manual non-autonomous Gemini and manual OpenRouter review workflows remain unaffected
Both autonomous prompts bound issue history to current-state/owner-direction sections and the latest five relevant comments per issue
Static AI safety checks validate both provider cooldowns and both prompt context bounds; branch self-test parses both reusable workflows
tasks.next_action: After PR #287 is merged, retarget this combined provider-cooldown and context-budget PR to main, rerun the exact-head branch self-test plus full AI safety and provenance checks, then review/merge only when all required checks are green.
